import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced by the # escaped headline and content respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog entry for safe web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- The function escapes all HTML special characters in both the headline and content to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). No additional HTML tags are allowed; if markup is desired, it must be added by the caller in a controlled manner. """ # Escape special characters to neutralize any injected HTML/JS. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Render the blog post using the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
